## Localities
- [Kokapet, Hyderabad](https://www.livarea.in/locality/kokapet/): Hyderabad's "Next Gachibowli". Price band ₹9,000–15,000/sqft; outlook 10–15% / yr.
- [Neopolis, Hyderabad](https://www.livarea.in/locality/neopolis/): Planned SEZ beside Gandipet Lake. Price band ₹9,000–15,000/sqft; outlook 10–15% / yr.
- [Financial District, Hyderabad](https://www.livarea.in/locality/financial-district/): Steady, established value. Price band ₹9,500–16,000/sqft; outlook 8–10% / yr.
- [Nanakramguda, Hyderabad](https://www.livarea.in/locality/nanakramguda/): Beside WaveRock & the office belt. Price band ₹9,500–16,000/sqft; outlook 8–10% / yr.
- [Puppalaguda, Hyderabad](https://www.livarea.in/locality/puppalaguda/): Between Manikonda & the Financial District. Price band ₹9,500–16,000/sqft; outlook 8–10% / yr.
- [HITEC City, Hyderabad](https://www.livarea.in/locality/hitec-city/): Established, metro-anchored demand. Price band ₹8,000–12,000/sqft; outlook Strong rental demand.
- [Kukatpally, Hyderabad](https://www.livarea.in/locality/kukatpally/): KPHB Metro, minutes from HITEC City. Price band ₹8,000–12,000/sqft; outlook Strong rental demand.
- [Rajendra Nagar, Hyderabad](https://www.livarea.in/locality/rajendra-nagar/): South Hyderabad's metro-linked bet. Price band ₹6,000–9,000/sqft; outlook 8–12% / yr.
- [Kollur, Hyderabad](https://www.livarea.in/locality/kollur/): Highest-upside entry point. Price band ₹5,700–13,000/sqft; outlook ~116% over 5 yrs.
- [Tellapur, Hyderabad](https://www.livarea.in/locality/tellapur/): Low-density premium living. Price band ₹7,700–10,300/sqft; outlook 12–14% / yr.
- [Narsingi, Hyderabad](https://www.livarea.in/locality/narsingi/): ORR-side, next to Kokapet. Price band ₹7,700–10,300/sqft; outlook 12–14% / yr.
- [Gachibowli, Hyderabad](https://www.livarea.in/locality/gachibowli/): The original IT corridor.
- [Kondapur, Hyderabad](https://www.livarea.in/locality/kondapur/): Residential belt beside HITEC City.
